Start a Spotify Jam

Spotify's real Jam feature lives inside their app — it's four taps away.

  1. Open Spotify on your phone. Start a song.
  2. Tap the device icon at the bottom of Now Playing → Start a Jam.
  3. Tap Share and copy the link.
  4. Paste it below — I'll send it to your partner in chat.

➕ Add a new location▾
Duplicate the meadow template:
  1. In index.html, find every block marked meadow and copy it.
  2. Rename to your new key (e.g. lavender) everywhere it appears.
  3. Add to LOCATIONS array (key + label).
  4. Add to ENABLED_LOCATIONS Set.
  5. Add to _ALL_LOCS array.
  6. Add an entry to LOCATION_ITEMS (data-item ids matching your SVG).
  7. Add an entry to BENCH_SKINS (rgb, stroke, slat, accent, glow, label).
  8. Add an entry to ATM (sky tint, wildlife type, night/sunset flags).
  9. Add to relevant MAGIC_LOCATION_ALLOW lists.
  10. Duplicate the SVG loc-bg, loc-frame, loc-wildlife groups in BOTH the session and landing SVGs.
  11. Add any new @keyframes your location uses.
Tip: keep data-item ids consistent across locations so dev nav toggles map naturally.
